name: dazzler
description: Dazzler turns your brief into expressive, purposeful frontend design.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic frontend design from your brief.
interface.longDescription: Choose and apply coherent fonts, colors, layouts and interactions automatically from the brief, with licensed assets, measured color roles and visual review. Optional controls support user-requested refinements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dazzler-frontend to design and build an interface from my brief, choosing fonts, colors, layout and interactions automatically.
